items.source: Merge, convert and process properties against the given bean factory.
items.translation: Merge、convert 和 process 属性，以针对给定的 Bean 工厂。

items.source: the converted value, to be used for processing
items.translation: 转换后的值，用于处理。

items.source: Property values can be converted after reading them in, through overriding the convertPropertyValue(String) method. For example, encrypted values can be detected and decrypted accordingly before processing them.
items.translation: 属性值可以在读取后通过重写convertPropertyValue(String)方法进行转换。例如，可以检测加密的值并在处理之前对其进行解密。

items.source: The default implementation will invoke convertPropertyValue(String) for each property value, replacing the original with the converted value.
items.translation: 默认实现将针对每个属性值调用convertPropertyValue(String)，并用转换后的值替换原始值。

items.source: The default implementation calls convertPropertyValue(String).
items.translation: 默认实现调用convertPropertyValue(String)。

items.source: Two concrete implementations are provided in the distribution:
items.translation: 分发中提供了两种具体实现：

items.source:
The default implementation simply returns the original value.
Can be overridden in subclasses, for example to detect
encrypted values and decrypt them accordingly.
items.translation: 默认实现仅返回原始值。可在子类中重写，例如用于检测加密值并相应地对其进行解密。

items.source: Apply the given Properties to the given BeanFactory.
items.translation: 将给定的属性应用到给定的 BeanFactory。

items.source: Set the order value of this object for sorting purposes.
items.translation: 设置此对象的排序顺序值。

items.source: PropertyOverrideConfigurer for "beanName.property=value" style overriding (pushing values from a properties file into bean definitions)
items.translation: PropertyOverrideConfigurer 用于 "beanName.property=value" 样式的覆盖（pushing 将值从属性文件推入 bean 定义）

items.source: PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer for replacing "${...}" placeholders (pulling values from a properties file into bean definitions)
items.translation: PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer 用于替换 "${...}" 占位符（从属性文件中提取值到 bean 定义中）

items.source: BeanInitializationException - if any properties cannot be loaded
items.translation: BeanInitializationException - 如果无法加载任何属性

items.source: BeansException - in case of errors
items.translation: BeansException - 在发生错误时

items.source: props - the Properties to convert
items.translation: props - 要转换的属性

items.source: propertyName - the name of the property that the value is defined for
items.translation: propertyName - 该值所定义的属性的名称

items.source: propertyValue - the original value from the properties source
items.translation: propertyValue - 来自属性源的原始值

items.source: originalValue - the original value from the properties source (properties file or local "properties")
items.translation: originalValue - 来自属性源（属性文件或本地"properties"）的原始值

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。
